text:
carol: FYI - after the kernel-chooser refactor merged in main, canary p95 on shortseqs jumped ~25%. Observed on dedicated clusters.
brad: any CI alerts? link?
deploy-bot: CI perf test failed: https://ci.internal/jobs/45321 — p95+20% on kernel-chooser test
alice: attaching sampling profiler output from canary (shortseq workload):
```
hot functions: kernel_selector::rank_candidates (46%), attn_kernel_dispatch (22%), kv_cache::lookup (9%)
call stacks show more full-attn fallback runs
``` 
ben: bisect started between commit 0f3a... and 7b2d... I'll post when narrowed
carol: commit range from PR #2145 (kernel chooser rewrite) looks suspicious, heuristics changed to prefer fused kernels more aggressively
brad: can we reproduce locally with minimal harness?
alice: repro script: `scripts/perf/run_shortseq.sh --seed=42 --seq=32 --iters=500` reproduces 20-30% p95 regression vs previous tip
ben: bisect result: narrows to commit 5c0f1a (chooser: add warmup_penalty factor and prefer low-latency kernels after warmup)
alice: profiler diff vs pre-5c0f1a shows KV cache miss rate up from 0.7% -> 3.6% during warmup window; extra KV misses trigger full-attn kernels more often
carol: that matches traces — seen more attn_kernel_dispatch hits at t=0..50 steps
brad: patch idea: reduce warmup_penalty or add a guard to keep previous kernel for first N tokens
alice: quick hotpatch suggested:
```
if (tokens_seen < 64) {
  chooser.force_prefer("stable_kernel_v2");
}
```
ben: ran hotpatch on canary, p95 back down ~12% (still slightly worse than baseline). rolling more nodes now
deploy-bot: canary hold activated by carol — no further rollout
carol: ok, schedule revert of 5c0f1a if hotpatch doesn't fully recover in 2h. assign @brad to open revert PR and @alice to craft follow-up with updated heuristics tests
brad: on it :thumbsup:
alice: created perf unit test that simulates KV warmup + chooser metrics (PR incoming)
infra-bot: trace link: https://traces.internal/trace/abcd-1234 — contains flamegraphs and sample traces
ben: I'll follow up with a long-run cluster run to validate steady-state
carol: thanks team. keep updates short here; prefer threads on PR for code. I'll post rollback if needed.
